title: Sea-Doo Partners With Senna Brand to Honor Ayrton Senna’s Timeless Legacy With an Exclusive Limited Edition
summary: The unprecedented partnership celebrates the year of Senna's third world title, with 1,991 units available worldwide. Sea-Doo partners with Senna Brand to create limited edition RXP-X Senna 350. Valcourt, Quebec, August 17, 2026 – Sea-Doo, iconic brand of BRP Inc.
